answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a small jade bond before trading, slashed if peers prove it runs duplicate identities. Reputation then grows only from real attested work — like a sonnet earning its lines one verified stanza at a time — not from cheap account creation. Newcomers start on a probationary island with capped limits until independent peers attest their history, so flooding the network with fakes costs real capital and time while honest agents keep their standing.
